name: Ananta Mulyono
intro: My work is about making complexity legible. I observe, ask questions, challenge assumptions, and bring structure across stakeholders, processes, and the design itself. I’m drawn to problems where the answer isn’t just on the screen, but in the people and context around it.

projects.title: Nationale Veteranendag
projects.text:
Every year a new campaign builds up to Veterans Day, which honours everyone who serves or has served in the armed forces. One year the new campaign came with a new website.

Using wireframes I restructured the homepage so it makes room for each year’s campaign message as well as veterans’ own stories, which carry the importance of remembering their service and the trauma that can come with it.

For the visual design I reused the margins, colours and typeface of the campaign materials.

projects.title: Kinfill
projects.text:
Let’s be honest: cleaning products are boring. Kinfill, a Rotterdam-based company, set out to change that with reusable glass bottles you refill with cleaning concentrate. At Connect Holland I redesigned their website, while our technical team took care of performance and made Kinfill’s logistics future-proof.

New fonts, colours and form language turned the site into more of an editorial experience, built around beautiful imagery of the products and tuned for shopping on desktop and mobile alike.

To give the site a personality we created Kay: Kinfill in person, a bar that stays on screen, talks to you, nudges you towards the next step and listens. Kay has three states: listening, talking and asking you to act.

projects.title: Linkit
projects.text:
Linkit has been connecting the ever-growing supply and demand for IT knowledge for over twenty years. Innovation is key in IT, so Linkit got a new website.

Linkit has a lot of knowledge to share. To keep that manageable for Linkit and its visitors, the site is built around one interaction: searching, or rather finding. Starting a search puts the focus on the search bar, mixed suggestions help visitors along, and colour-coded tags tell the content types apart.

I did the visual and interaction design for desktop and mobile; Linkit and Connect Holland then built it together in an Agile collaboration.
